article.story: INDIANAPOLIS -- — Donovan Oday's 26 points helped Northern Kentucky defeat IU Indianapolis 84-81 on Thursday. Dan Gherezgher Jr. added 24 points while going 8 of 17 from the floor, including 5 for 11 from 3-point range, for the Norse (16-11, 8-8 Horizon League). Tae Dozier had 19 points and shot 5 for 8 (3 for 4 from 3-point range) and 6 of 8 from the free-throw line. Kyler D'Augustino led the way for the Jaguars (7-20, 3-13) with 22 points. IU Indianapolis also got 16 points, five assists and two steals from Jaxon Edwards. Finley Woodward finished with 15 points and six rebounds. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
